references.text: Moses exhorts the people to teach their children and grandchildren about what they have seen and heard from the Lord.
A nearly identical command to teach God's words to one's children, speaking of them at home and abroad, when lying down and when rising up.
God says that Abraham must command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord.
The psalmist emphasizes the importance of telling future generations about the Lord's deeds and commands.
The exhortation to train a child in the way he should go, so that when he is old he will not depart from it.
Paul exhorts fathers to bring up their children in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
Timothy has known the holy Scriptures from childhood, which shows the fruits of faithful teaching in the home.
